## Silver Dragon, Mature Adult (CR 15)

**XP** 51,200  
 LG Huge dragon (cold)  
 **Init** +4; **Senses** dragon senses, fog vision; Perception +27; **Aura** frightful presence (210 ft., DC 24)  

**Defense**

 **AC** 32, touch 8, flat-footed 32 (+24 natural, -2 size)  
 **hp** 342 (19d12+114)  
 **Fort** +16, **Ref** +13, **Will** +18  
 **DR** 10/magic; **Immune** acid, cold, paralysis, sleep; **SR** 26  
 **Weaknesses** vulnerability to fire  

**Offense**

 **Speed** 40 ft., fly 200 ft. (average); cloudwalking, graceful flight  
 **Melee** bite +27 (2d8+13/19–20), 2 claws +26 (2d6+9), tail slap +24 (2d6+13), 2 wings +24 (1d8+4)  
 **Space** 15 ft.; **Reach** 10 ft. (15 ft. with bite)  
 **Special Attacks** breath weapon (50-ft. cone, DC 24, 14d8 cold), crush (2d8+13, DC 24), paralyzing breath  
 **Spell-Like Abilities** (CL 19th; concentration +24)  

  
  At will—
  *detect evil, feather fall, fog cloud*
  
 **Spells Known** (CL 9th; concentration +14)  

  
  4th (5/day)—
  *dimension door, restoration*
  

  3rd (7/day)—
  *cure serious wounds, dispel magic,*  
  *[wind wall](../../magic/spells/wind-wall.md)*
  

  2nd (7/day)—
  *[augury,* ](../../magic/spells/augury.md)
  *cure moderate wounds, invisibility, web* (DC 17)
  

  1st (8/day)—
  *[alarm](../../magic/spells/alarm.md)*,
  *bless, divine favor, shield, true strike*
  

  0 (at will)—
  *detect magic, flare* (DC 15),
  *light, message, prestidigitation, read magic, stabilize, resistance

* Note: A silver dragon can cast cleric spells as arcane spells
  

  

**Statistics**

 **Str** 29, **Dex** 10, **Con** 21, **Int** 20, **Wis** 21, **Cha** 20  
 **Base Atk** +19; **CMB** +30; **CMD** 40 (44 vs. trip)  
 **Feats** Flyby Attack, Hover, Improved Critical (bite), Improved Initiative, Iron Will, Lighting Reflexes, Multiattack, Vital Strike, Weapon Focus (bite), [Toughness](../../rules/feats/toughness.md); [Power Attack](../../rules/feats/power-attack.md) (no feat needed)  
*House rules: Power Attack needs no feat; in their place: Toughness.*  
 **Skills** Acrobatics +19 (+23 jump), Diplomacy +27, Fly +18, Heal +27, Intimidate +27, Knowledge (arcana, local, nobility) +27, Perception +27, Sense Motive +27, Spellcraft +27  
 **Languages** Auran, Common, Draconic, Dwarven, Giant, Terran  
 **SQ** change shape  

**Special Abilities**

 **Change Shape (Su)** A silver dragon can assume any animal or humanoid form 3/day as if using *polymorph*.  

 **Cloudwalking (Su)**
